description: Per-chip (per-die) shipment attestation. Records lot ID, die XY coordinate, libp2p peer-ID burned at eFuse, bin result, Council §2(a)(c) review pointer, and the religious-corp adherent DID the chip is leased to. Per ADR-2605242500 §Decision 4 + 6, ADR-2605242545 §Decision 1 + 4, shared-ip/libp2p-nic peer-ID convention.

dieXY.description: Die location on the wafer, e.g., 'x23y17'.

peerId.description: ed25519 peer-ID burned at eFuse during shared-ip/libp2p-nic IP block init. Per ADR-2605242530 + shared-ip/libp2p-nic/README.md.

silenForceReviewUri.description: AT URI of the silenForceReview record that gates this lot. Per ADR-2605242500 §Decision 4 + ADR-2605242545 §Decision 4. REQUIRED — no silicon ships without a passing review.

leasedToDid.description: DID of the religious-corp adherent (SBT holder) this chip is leased to. Donated silicon is inalienable (ADR-2605242500 §Decision 6) — lease, never sale.

councilAttestationTxHash.description: Optional. On-chain Council 5-of-7 Safe transaction hash that ratified this lot's manufacturing.
